top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Diverge From US Rally, Oil Advances: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks slipped, in contrast to Wall Street’s record-setting rally, as enthusiasm over the earnings outlook failed to carry over to the region. Treasuries fell as oil climbed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. military in Okinawa pauses operations and enforces curfew in wake of murder
top_signals.summary: The two-day operational pause from noon Wednesday will be followed by a 30-day curfew dubbed a "Period of Reflection."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Coinbase Pro to return; Deribit integration creates Coinbase Global Exchange
top_signals.summary: Coinbase plans to relaunch Coinbase Pro by year-end and has completed its Deribit integration, creating Coinbase Global Exchange.
